{"type":"thought","data":"Evaluating the Pumas"}
{"type":"thought","data":" vs. Cruz Azul draw "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.265 for a draw aligns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" closely with implied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probabilities from "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bookmaker odds. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is pricing in a draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as the most likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSeveral predictive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" models also favor a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw. Dimers projects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 26%, footywow 25%, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"xGscore 24%, and Squawka"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Signal 24%. Wincomparator"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows Cruz Azul at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"40.73%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo offers a small "}
{"type":"thought","data":"edge over Yes. The expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of a draw bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly zero, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the no-draw bet yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a slight positive expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" refers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning the bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":" No carries a 73.5% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"chance of winning, compared"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 26.5% for Yes."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's prior record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 6-6 with a net loss"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of -210. Favorites "}
{"type":"thought","data":"paid only small amounts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while underdogs won"}
{"type":"thought","data":" large. The goal is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to win, not just maximize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability. A draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet would yield roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 277 tokens if correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but lose the full 100"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stake if wrong."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" favors the No "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome. Yet winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the competition requires"}
{"type":"thought","data":" maximizing expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit against other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents, not just picking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the highest probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If most competitors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet No and it does "}
{"type":"thought","data":"not draw, everyone wins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" small. If it draws,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" everyone loses 100."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The key is being right"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when others are wrong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or having better expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value.\n\nI should check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bench bet help and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"historical price data"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for more information."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I also need to verify"}
{"type":"thought","data":" whether the match has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" already started and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" look for any late team"}
{"type":"thought","data":" news or injuries."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe match has not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"started. The market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"closes in about five"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minutes.\n\nRaw bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds imply roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"27.1% for a draw, 26.1%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Pumas, and 46.8%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Cruz Azul after"}
{"type":"thought","data":" removing vig. This "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is slightly higher than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 26.5%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSharp no-vig probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from xGscore books "}
{"type":"thought","data":"land near 26.3%, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" footywow ELO suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 24%. The average model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate is roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 25.2%. Historical head-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" data shows the teams"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have drawn twice in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" recent meetings, including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 0-0 result in May"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2026."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRecent head-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" history shows a draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate of 33% in the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"last six meetings, higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the base rate."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pumas are struggling"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with poor form and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sit 13th in the league"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with only 12 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from ten games. Cruz"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Azul has better form"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and sits 7th with 16"}
{"type":"thought","data":" points, though their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" defense is leaky having"}
{"type":"thought","data":" conceded heavily against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Toluca, America, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Monterrey."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected goals are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 1.35 for Pumas"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 1.70 for Cruz Azul,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggesting a total "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of about three goals."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The Poisson model is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" being run to verify"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The recommendation "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is to bet No."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Mexico City derby"}
{"type":"thought","data":" context does not favor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a draw. Recent meetings"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have been decisive "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and high-scoring. Cruz"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Azul is only a slight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite, so the draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price looks efficient."}

{"type":"thought","data":"The draw market is efficient."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The price of 0.265 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reflects the true probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nModels estimate the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw at 24-26%, slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" below the vig-adjusted"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price. Cruz Azul is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the clear favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pumas is the home underdog."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Several key players"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are out with injuries,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" including Kevin Mier,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" who is missing due "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to international duty."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMier's absence means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Gudino Portillo will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" start in goal. Several"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key Cruz Azul players"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are also questionable."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If they miss the match,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the team is significantly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" weakened. That would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" increase Pumas's win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance and could shift"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability toward "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expensive. The no-vig"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw probability is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 25.5%, but "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the ask price is 27 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"cents. The no-draw side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is fair at about 73.4%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 74.5%, so buying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No looks like a solid"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value play."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe edge is negligible."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Buying No at 0.74 yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly zero expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value against fair "}
{"type":"thought","data":"odds near 74%. The real"}
{"type":"thought","data":" choice is between a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slight loss and a clear"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite. No is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most likely outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe goal is to maximize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" score against the other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents, not just to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win the market. Betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No would yield roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 35 tokens profit if"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it resolves, while "}
{"type":"thought","data":"betting Yes would pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 270 tokens but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" carries a much lower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of winning. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The edge is so small"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that neither side offers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" meaningful expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. The user's current"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record is -210 tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so they need any available"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge to climb."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Clásico capitalino"}
{"type":"thought","data":" context matters. Both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" teams need points, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and missing key players"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may force a more defensive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" style that increases"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Historical data from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the Olimpico shows "}
{"type":"thought","data":"mixed results, with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"one draw in three home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" meetings. The draw "}
{"type":"thought","data":"rate in Liga MX is typically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" around 28 to 30 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe price is fair."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will bet No at 0.74"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and place the trade"}
{"type":"thought","data":" now."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will cap the bet at 0.75 to avoid paying the default 0.79 limit. The best ask is 0.74, so my 100-token stake will fill immediately."}
